requirements.text: For a managed asset that declares no codex.allow_implicit_invocation, the candidate agents/openai.yaml carries no upstream allow_implicit_invocation; other policy fields are kept and an empty policy is dropped.
A declared codex.allow_implicit_invocation overrides the upstream value in agents/openai.yaml.
Codex metadata without an undeclared allow_implicit_invocation stays byte-identical, and a second normalization pass reports no changes.
A refresh judges repository impact from the candidate-versus-repository diff, not the normalization change summary, and stops when paths outside the authorized set would change.
Network access happens only through the pinned prepare flow; no pull, argumentless fetch, remote update, or package manager is used.

cases.prompt: Refresh the Matt source; upstream grill-me ships policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false.
cases.initial_state: grill-me has no invocation_policy in managed-resources.yaml; the upstream snapshot contains fixtures/upstream-restricted-openai.yaml.

assertions.text: The candidate metadata has no policy key.
display_name and short_description keep the upstream values.

forbidden_actions: Hand-edit the committed file instead of normalizing the candidate.

cases.prompt: Refresh the Matt source and confirm grilling stays user-invoked in Codex.
cases.initial_state: grilling declares codex.allow_implicit_invocation: false; upstream grilling metadata has no policy.
cases.expected_output: The candidate grilling agents/openai.yaml contains policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false.

assertions.text: The declared value is present after normalization.

forbidden_actions: Strip a policy that the manifest declares.

cases.prompt: Run plan twice on an unchanged source.
cases.initial_state: A managed asset whose upstream metadata already lacks allow_implicit_invocation.
cases.expected_output: The metadata stays byte-identical and the second pass reports no normalization changes.

assertions.text: A second normalization pass reports no changed paths.

forbidden_actions: Re-serialize metadata that needs no change.

cases.prompt: Regenerate only the Matt source metadata fix; only grill-me and setup metadata may change.
cases.initial_state: The pinned SHA and pin ref exist in the workspace cache; the plan summary lists many normalization changes.
cases.expected_output: The agent compares the candidate with the repository, finds only the two authorized paths, applies with network protocols blocked, and reports any extra path as a stop condition.

assertions.text: Repository impact is taken from the candidate-versus-repository diff.
Plan and apply run without a mutable or unpinned fetch.

forbidden_actions: Treat the normalization change summary as the repository change set.
Run git pull, an argumentless git fetch, or git remote update.

pass: The transcript shows a candidate-versus-repository diff limited to the two authorized files before or after apply.
Commands run with network protocols blocked or only through pinned prepare.
fail: The agent approves the refresh from the 48-path normalization summary alone.
The agent fetches upstream outside pinned prepare.
